sources.title: Actual exact-fence and independent bounded CPU verification
Softmax ratio, positive-T order and fixed-logit uniform limit
sources.details: For finite logits z_i and T>0, p_i=exp(z_i/T)/Σ_jexp(z_j/T), hence p_i/p_j=exp((z_i-z_j)/T). Positive division and strictly increasing exp preserve order. As T→∞, exp(z_i/T)→1 and p_i→1/N (N=3 here). Independent math.exp denominators are58.316431861603284,10.037777369630778,5.0023072451467865 atT1,2,4. Multiplying all logits and T by2 leaves z/T identical. Dividing final probabilities byT gives total1/T, not a normalized distribution. For fixed teacher, CE(p,q) gradient=(q-p)/T; with T² and average over2 valid positions it isT*(q-p)/2. Observed CPU float tolerances and actual values retained in cpu-observations.json.
